task_summary: Analyze camera egomotion and detect dynamic objects in a video, outputting motion labels as JSON and binary masks as compressed NPZ in CSR format.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct functional domains: (1) video I/O and frame sampling, (2) egomotion estimation and motion classification, and (3) dynamic object detection with CSR mask serialization. However, egomotion and dynamic detection share the same optical flow/feature tracking pipeline and are tightly coupled per frame-pair, so they belong together. Separating video I/O from the analysis logic and output formatting keeps concerns clean while avoiding over-decomposition.

skills.name: evo-video-sampling
skills.description: Extracts frames from an MP4 video file at a specified target FPS using sequential reading to avoid seek unreliability. Returns sampled grayscale frames and their original frame indices.
skills.responsibility: Video decoding, FPS calculation, sequential frame sampling, BGR-to-grayscale conversion. No analysis logic.
dr_sections: 1. Video Frame Sampling Strategies with OpenCV
1.1 API Usage for Video Capture and Frame Rate Calculation
1.2 The Unreliability of `CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES` in MP4 Files
6.1 BGR vs RGB Color Space Constraints

skills.name: evo-egomotion-dynamic-analysis
skills.description: For consecutive sampled frame pairs, computes sparse optical flow, estimates camera egomotion via partial affine transform (classifying into Pan/Tilt/Dolly/Roll/Stay labels), and detects dynamic objects via homography-based motion compensation and frame differencing. Outputs motion labels and binary masks.
skills.responsibility: Feature detection, optical flow (Lucas-Kanade), affine partial 2D estimation for egomotion classification, homography estimation for motion compensation, frame differencing, morphological cleanup, and threshold-based motion label assignment.
dr_sections: 2. Optical Flow Computation for Egomotion Estimation
2.1 Dense Optical Flow: Gunnar Farneback's Algorithm
3. Dynamic Object Detection without Deep Learning
3.1 Separating Egomotion using Homography and Warping
3.2 Difference Imaging and Binary Mask Generation
6.2 Data Types and Optical Flow Expectations

skills.name: evo-output-serialization
skills.description: Serializes egomotion labels to JSON with frame-interval keys and binary masks to NPZ in CSR sparse format using only NumPy (no SciPy dependency).
skills.responsibility: Manual dense-to-CSR conversion using NumPy, NPZ file writing with compressed sparse masks, JSON export with interval-keyed motion labels.
dr_sections: 4. Manual Construction of SciPy Sparse CSR Matrices
